name: Tall Building Inventory
description: Inventory of tall buildings in San Francisco, focusing on attributes that are relevant to building performance during an earthquake or to post-earthquake recovery. Where possible, the attributes were collected from permitting documents at the Department of Building Inspections. As of October 1, 2018, this database includes a complete list of the 156 buildings taller than 240 ft, as well as another 24 buildings over 160 ft. For more information on the Tall Building Safety Strategy, see http://OneSanFrancisco.org/Resilient-SF. If you find any errors or emissions in this database, please contact us at cpp@sfgov.org. For any other issues, please scroll down to "contact the dataset owner" on this page.

objectid.name: OBJECTID
objectid.description: System ID generated by Esri software

mapblocklot.name: MapBlockLot
mapblocklot.description: The block and lot number of the representative parcel for the building

mbl_unique.name: MBL_Unique
mbl_unique.description: The MapBlockLot (MBL) number, modified with a cardinal direction if multiple buildings share the same MBL

retrofit_date.name: Retrofit_Date
retrofit_date.description: Year the building was seismically retrofit, if known

height_ft.name: Height_ft
height_ft.description: Height of the building, in feet

stories_above_grade.name: Stories_Above_Grade
stories_above_grade.description: Number of stories above ground level

stories_below_grade.name: Stories_Below_Grade
stories_below_grade.description: Number of stories below ground level

occupancy.name: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Occupancy type of building, consistent with San Francisco's Land Use categorization

structural_material.name: Structural_Material
structural_material.description: Structural material of the building (Steel, Reinforced Concrete, or Mixed)

structural_system.name: Structural_System
structural_system.description: Lateral Force Resisting System (LFRS) of the building

structural_types.name: Structural_Types
structural_types.description: Broad categorization of the LFRS (Steel Moment Frame, Steel Braced Frame, RC Shear Wall)

facade_material.name: Facade_Material
facade_material.description: Façade material, classified by visual identification

borp_report.name: BORP_Report
borp_report.description: Is the building part of Building Occupancy Resumption Program (BORP)

instrumented.name: Instrumented
instrumented.description: Is the building seismically instrumented to record earthquake motion?

square_footage.name: Square_Footage
square_footage.description: Square footage of the building (from Feb. 2018 SFFD records. Not all buildings have a match.)

fire_resistence_type.name: Fire_Resistence_Type
fire_resistence_type.description: Fire resistance of building materials (from Feb. 2018 SFFD records. Not all buildings have a match.)

percent_sprinklered.name: Percent_Sprinklered
percent_sprinklered.description: Percentage of building with sprinklers installed (from Feb. 2018 SFFD records. Not all buildings have a match.)

liquefaction_potential.name: Liquefaction_Potential
liquefaction_potential.description: Classification of the liquefaction potential at the building's centroid (Very High to Very Low)

bedrockdepth_mean.name: BedrockDepth_MEAN
bedrockdepth_mean.description: Mean depth to bedrock over the building's footprint (based on a 1961 USGS bedrock map and current day topographic data)

bedrockdepth_max.name: BedrockDepth_MAX
bedrockdepth_max.description: Maximum depth to bedrock over the building's footprint (based on a 1961 USGS bedrock map and current day topographic data)

bedrockdepth_min.name: BedrockDepth_MIN
bedrockdepth_min.description: Minimum depth to bedrock over the building's footprint (based on a 1961 USGS bedrock map and current day topographic data)

permit_date_1.name: Permit_Date_1
permit_date_1.description: Year of any date stamps found on the permit documents

permit_date_2.name: Permit_Date_2
permit_date_2.description: Year of any date stamps found on the permit documents

permit_date_3.name: Permit_Date_3
permit_date_3.description: Year of any date stamps found on the permit documents

completion_date.name: Completion_Date
completion_date.description: Year of completion (from a CFC document or, if not other date is available, from Emporis)

building_code_year.name: Building_Code_Year
building_code_year.description: The date of the applicable design code (if noted)

base_plan_size.name: Base_Plan_Size
base_plan_size.description: Dimensions of the plan at ground level

tower_plan_size.name: Tower_Plan_Size
tower_plan_size.description: Dimensions of the plan for the tower

architectural_notes.name: Architectural_Notes
architectural_notes.description: Description of any relevant architectural features (set backs, plan shape, etc)

atrium_location.name: Atrium_Location
atrium_location.description: Story on which an atrium is located

mep_levels.name: MEP_levels
mep_levels.description: Story on which MEP equipment is located

primary_source.name: Primary_Source
primary_source.description: Primary source the data was collected from (BORP reports, DBI permits, Emporis, Peer Reviewers)
